slack_app_token_hint: Basic Information → App-Level Tokens → Generate Token and Scopes. Add connections:write and copy the generated xapp-… token.
slack_bot_token_hint: OAuth & Permissions → OAuth Tokens → Bot User OAuth Token. Starts with xoxb- and appears after you install the app.
slack_callback_hint: The manifest registers this URL under OAuth & Permissions → Redirect URLs. If your PP address changes, update it there and save the change.
slack_channel_hint: Invite @ProjectProject into the channel first. Refresh the list after inviting it.
slack_client_id_hint: Basic Information → App Credentials → Client ID. Copy the ID from the same app as your tokens.
slack_client_secret_hint: Basic Information → App Credentials → Client Secret → Show. Use Client Secret, not Signing Secret.
slack_credential_notice: Credentials are encrypted on your PP server and are never shown again.
slack_credential_types_notice: Signing Secret and Verification Token are not needed. PP uses Socket Mode, which requires the bot token and app-level token instead.
slack_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Slack and stop project notifications?
slack_error_app_mismatch: The app-level token belongs to a different Slack app than the bot token. Use tokens from the same app.
slack_error_auth: Slack rejected the credentials. Check the tokens and app permissions.
slack_error_channel: Invite the bot into an active channel before connecting it.
slack_error_credentials: PP can't read the saved Slack credentials. Disconnect and connect Slack again.
slack_error_disconnect_first: Disconnect the current Slack workspace before connecting a different app or workspace.
slack_error_encryption: Secret storage is not configured. Ask your server administrator to configure encryption.
slack_error_generic: Slack could not complete the request. Please try again.
slack_error_rate_limited: Slack is busy. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
slack_error_socket: The Slack connection is unavailable. PP will retry automatically.
slack_error_workspace_connected: This Slack workspace is already connected to another PP organization.
slack_host_notice: Use an HTTPS domain for PP, not localhost or an IP address. Your browser must be able to reach it for account linking. Socket Mode does not need a public Events API Request URL.
slack_icon_instructions: In Slack, open Basic Information → Display Information and upload the downloaded app icon. The manifest does not include it.
slack_oauth_error: Slack account linking failed. Check that you chose the connected workspace and try again.
slack_profile_description: Link your Slack identity to enable ticket previews when you share links. Everyone in the conversation can see the summary; opening the ticket still requires PP access.
slack_profile_empty: Your organizations have not connected a Slack workspace yet.
slack_project_unavailable: An organization admin needs to connect Slack first.
slack_publish_notice: Selected updates will be visible to everyone in this channel.
slack_setup_app_body: Open Basic Information → App-Level Tokens → Generate Token and Scopes. Name the token ProjectProject, add the connections:write scope, then choose Generate. Copy the generated token into the field below.
slack_setup_bot_body: In Slack, open OAuth & Permissions. Under OAuth Tokens, install the app to your workspace and choose Allow. Copy the Bot User OAuth Token into the field below. If Slack requires approval, ask a workspace admin to approve the installation.
slack_setup_bot_title: Install the app and copy the bot token
slack_setup_client_body: Open Basic Information → App Credentials. Copy Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below. These let people link their Slack identity so PP can check their access before showing ticket previews.
slack_setup_create_body: Choose your Slack workspace, review the prefilled settings, then select Create. The manifest already enables Socket Mode and the permissions PP needs.
slack_setup_create_title: Create the app from the manifest
slack_setup_instructions: Use one Slack app for this PP installation. Keep its settings open as you work through setup.
slack_validation_app_token: Enter the app-level token starting with xapp-.
slack_validation_bot_token: Enter the Bot User OAuth Token starting with xoxb-.
slack_validation_client_id: Enter the Client ID, such as 123456789.123456789.
slack_validation_client_secret: Enter the Client Secret from App Credentials.
